decisions.statement: Every biome call is refused whether that call reads or writes.
A biome call in the command word is refused whether it reads or writes.
The refusal names the apply rather than the draft as where the linter runs.
Biome reached by a path is the same call and is refused.
Biome reached through a runner is the same call and is refused.
A prefix that only runs the call behind that prefix does not hide a biome call from this hook.
A package script reaching biome is not read here.
No package script now reaches akasha.
A biome write reaches akasha content with no gate.
A biome write reaches akasha content with no index.
A biome write reaches akasha content with no commit.
`prettier` reaching akasha content is refused as `biome` reaching it is.

definition: a refusal of the biome calls an agent makes outside the akasha commands
